item.title: Texas ranks 9th highest in US property tax rates, according to new study
item.description: Texas has an effective property tax rate of 1.245% for owner-occupied homes. That is significantly higher than the national effective rate of 0.888%.

item.title: Dallas endorses giving up control of DART board in attempt to save service
item.description: Dallas approved of a new governance structure for DART as the service attempts to entice cities into canceling withdrawal elections scheduled for May.Dallas city council voted in favor of a resolution that would see the city giving up majority control of DART's board. item.title: Shooting leaves one dead on Preston Road in Far North Dallas
item.description: One person is dead following a shooting on Preston Road in Far North Dallas.Around 2:15 p.m. Wednesday, Dallas police responded to a shooting call near 5801 Preston Road in Far North Dallas. Dallas Fire & Rescue also responded.First responders found an unresponsive man who had been shot. The victim was later pronounced dead.Police have not found a suspect or motive for the shooting.Dallas PD said this is still an ongoing investigation.

item.title: Police release video of third Dallas officer-involved shooting this year
item.description: The Dallas Police Department gave an update and shared video of a deadly officer-involved shooting that happened over the weekend.The suspect in the case reportedly charged at officers with a box cutter and reached for an officer’s service weapon. He can be heard in body camera video asking the officers to shoot him.Dallas Officer-Involved ShootingPolice on Wednesday identified the suspect as 22-year-old James Thomas. item.title: Texas sues Snapchat alleging addictive design and child safety violations
item.description: Texas announced that they are filing a lawsuit against Snap, Inc., the parent company of the popular social media company Snapchat. Snap, Inc. allegedly violates the Texas Deceptive Trade Practices Consumer Protection Act (DTPA) by failing to adequately warn parents and consumers about exposure to inappropriate material and the app’s addictive design.
